titulo: Sand Dunes That Move at the Speed of a Dembow Beat

Sand Dunes That Move at the Speed of a Dembow Beat

Watch the tape stop around 16 seconds. The dunes slow down with the beat and freeze in the silence, then race on the drop. A wordless exploration of contour lines and music.

descripcion:
Sand dunes seen from above in a topographic map animation, drifting downwind as fast as the music lets them.
Watch the tape stop around 16 seconds: the dunes slow down on the same curve and freeze in the silence. On the drop the land runs six times faster.
A wordless NAOS exploration of contour lines and sound.

Music made with ElevenLabs.
Every NAOS strategy and its sources: https://hardlypythonnmr.github.io/naos-site/biblioteca/

#topographicmap #dembow #generativeart
alt: Animated topographic map of a sand dune field seen from straight above. Blue contour lines on hot orange drift diagonally as the dunes move downwind. As the music slows to a stop the orange drains to dark red and one frame holds in silence. On the drop the picture cuts to flat bands of bright color with black edges, drawn at a choppy 12 frames a second. The dunes race and the colors shift on each bar. No text, no people.
